deadline.value: Apply by June 15, 2027 for Fall admission (November 1 for Spring admission).
deadline.quote: Deadlines: June 15 for fall, November 1 for spring

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are required for Computer Science PhD admission.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must meet general graduate admission requirements in addition to the following program-specific requirements: | Official GRE score

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Computer Science.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Department of Computer Science does not state whether a faculty advisor must be contacted prior to applying.

funding.value: Graduate teaching and research assistantships are assigned by the department ($25,865 stipend + 100% tuition waiver for a 1.0 FTE TA/RA in AY 2026-27).
funding.quote: These positions are assigned by the student's department/program and are subject to the agreement between UMass Boston and UAW/Graduate Employees Organization (GEO). | Full Assistantship | 18.00 | 1.00 | $1,293.25 | $25,865.00 | 100%

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited institution with a minimum 3.0 undergraduate GPA.
entry_route.quote: A minimum, cumulative GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (or international equivalent) in all undergraduate work | A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution of recognized standing or an international equivalent at the time of enrollment
